scope: Read-only inspection of frozen source, plan and retained producer/transport provenance. Offline no-signal synthetic probes and read-only exact assignment/body checks. No network or process control performed; original serial attempt untouched.

findings.issue: Cap-triggered stop sends TERM to currently enumerated descendants, waits two seconds, sends TERM to root, then reports stopped and raises. It never checks all descendants exited, escalates to KILL or verifies quiescence. A TERM-ignoring child can continue to write after byte/disk/time cap.
findings.probe: term_ignoring_descendant in probe.stdout: mocked child101 remains live while terminal guard receipt says stopped; signals contain only CONT and TERM.

findings.issue: After SIGCONT the supervisor has no failure finalizer. Snapshot, stat, JSON, receipt-write or other exceptions abandon the owned resumed processes and leave running receipt without original error or cleanup result.
findings.probe: snapshot_error_after_resume in probe.stdout: injected snapshot RuntimeError propagates, receipt remains running and the only signals are CONT.
